items.title: Tata Steel bets on higher prices, cost savings to lift FY27 margins
items.description: Tata Steel anticipates improved margins this fiscal year, driven by higher steel prices and domestic volume growth, alongside ongoing cost savings. However, escalating raw material expenses and European operational challenges may temper this expansion. The company expects a significant increase in Indian realisations, partly due to renewed automotive contracts, while managing rising input costs and geopolitical freight pressures.
